originalTitle: Has Trump won over voters with his midterm convention?
summary: The BBC's North America editor Sarah Smith breaks down the main takeaways from the first-ever Republican convention held in the middle of a US presidential term.
content:
Republicans gathered in Dallas for the closing day of the party's first-ever convention held in the middle of a US presidential term, where US President Donald Trump and Vice President JD Vance spoke to voters.

The aim of the convention was to boost enthusiasm among supporters, even as protesters of Trump gathered outside.

The BBC's North America editor Sarah Smith breaks down the main takeaways from the two day event.
chineseTitle: 特朗普是否通过中期代表大会赢得了选民的支持？
chineseSummary: BBC 北美编辑莎拉·史密斯 (Sarah Smith) 详细分析了在美国总统任期中期举行的首次共和党全国代表大会的主要内容。
chineseContent:
共和党人聚集在达拉斯，参加在美国总统任期中期举行的该党首次代表大会的闭幕日，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普和副总统 JD·万斯在会​​上向选民发表了讲话。

大会的目的是提高支持者的热情，尽管特朗普的抗议者聚集在外面。

BBC 北美编辑莎拉·史密斯 (Sarah Smith) 详细分析了为期两天的活动的主要内容。
